verdict.rationale: Missive's docs say users can connect Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, or IMAP accounts, with full two-way Gmail sync and support for IMAP/SMTP servers that use untrusted certificates. Its docs also describe managing email, SMS, and WhatsApp in one shared inbox, which covers the cross-provider, single-place goal. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of running several mixed-provider accounts side by side, and Microsoft 365 is named only as Outlook/Exchange rather than explicitly.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place

citations.quote: Connect Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, or IMAP email accounts to Missive.
Connect Gmail or Google Workspace to Missive. Full two-way sync with labels.
Manage email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more in one shared inbox.
Connect to mail servers with untrusted certificates.
